Reliability Engineer

Salary: $91,200 - $136,800 | Location: Hybrid - Columbus OH / Chicago IL / Hartford CT / Charlotte NC (3 days/week, Tue-Thu) | Full Time
Visa Sponsorship: Not Available | No STEM OPT I-983 support
Division: Corporate / HIMCO IT

About The Hartford:
The Hartford is a leading insurance company with more than 200 years of history.

Role Overview:
The Hartford's Corporate/HIMCO IT team is seeking a Reliability Engineer to lead infrastructure resilience, ensuring stability and performance of systems in cloud and SaaS environments.

Responsibilities:

Platform Reliability:
- Instrument code/application technology stacks to generate metrics on technology health: availability, performance, quality, currency, and resiliency.
- Influence technical strategy across the organization with cross-functional awareness.
- Act as technical leader for supported applications, with depth and breadth in technologies, applications, integration, and business domain.

DevSecOps:
- Develop effective tooling, alerts, and response mechanisms to identify and address reliability risks via automation.
- Enhance delivery flow by engineering solutions that increase delivery speed while maintaining reliability standards.
- Implement preventative controls and drive increased automation and self-healing capabilities.
- Improve cost efficiency baselines.

IT Operations:
- Drive triaging and service restoration of high-impact incidents to minimize MTTR.
- Design and implement intelligent incident routing, enhanced monitoring/alerting, and automated service restoration.
- Take proactive measures to prevent high-impact incidents.
- Maintain continuity of Hartford and third-party assets supporting business functions.
- Keep IT application and infrastructure metadata repositories current.

AI-Driven Automation:
- Research and implement AI-based anomaly detection to predict infrastructure failures and automate preventive measures.
- Develop AI-powered troubleshooting copilots and LLM-driven operational assistants to accelerate incident resolution and root cause analysis.
- Implement AI/ML-based runbooks to automate system recovery and optimize operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
- 3+ years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering, SRE, or DevOps.
- Hands-on experience with observability tools: Splunk, Dynatrace, CloudWatch.
- Deep knowledge of IaC with Terraform, CloudFormation.
- Proven ability to optimize CI/CD pipelines, automate deployments, and enforce DevSecOps best practices.
- Expertise in cloud platforms (AWS) and Kubernetes-based microservices environments.
- Strong proficiency in Python and Java for infrastructure automation and tooling development.
- Experience with Oracle and SQL Server relational database technologies.
- Demonstrated experience working within Agile frameworks.

Nice to Have:
- Experience in AI/ML frameworks for observability, predictive failure detection, and AI-driven troubleshooting.
- Knowledge of open-source database technologies.

Note: Hybrid role, must be authorized to work in the US. HIMCO Code of Ethics compliance and holdings disclosure required.

Senior Infrastructure Engineer

Salary: $164,595 - $212,744 + Equity | Location: Remote (Global, preference for 4+ hours EMEA overlap) | Full Time
Department: Engineering | 4-day workweeks

About Buffer:
Buffer creates social media and brand-building software for small businesses, creators, and individuals. Fully distributed team, profitable for 15 years, transparent by default (open metrics, salaries, roadmap). Millions of creators use Buffer to publish and grow on the social web.

About the Role:
Join two seasoned Infrastructure Engineers on a small, deliberate, high-leverage team. Own a meaningful slice of three shifts: keeping reliability at a higher bar, modernizing the foundation, and treating engineers across Buffer as customers. You'll run the platform that lets every Buffer engineer ship, and indirectly lets millions of creators publish and grow.

What You'll Work On:
- Own day-to-day reliability of the production platform. Keep EKS, ArgoCD, and AWS surface area boring. Tune autoscaling, handle incident response so each incident teaches something new rather than repeating itself. On-call is distributed across all engineers, roughly once per quarter.
- Build progressive delivery into something the rest of engineering trusts. Implement Argo Rollouts with clean rollback paths (seconds to minutes from 'bad deploy' to 'reverted').
- Build developer tools as products: evolve BIBEs (Buffer Isolated Build Environments, per-PR full-stack staging), in-house local dev environment (Hermes), and CLI tooling so the inner loop is fast, frictionless, and parallel-friendly for AI agents. Measure adoption, talk to users, iterate.
- Reduce operational toil with AI. Automate low-risk workflows end-to-end so the team spends time on hard problems, not repeat ones.
- Keep the stack current: drive lifecycle upgrades for Node.js, Python, Kubernetes, EKS, Helm, and Terraform-managed surface area. Own infra-side security vulnerabilities.
- Improve platform economics: lead visibility work on Datadog, AWS rightsizing, and log filters so observability and cloud spend grow slower than the company.
- Partner with EPD (Engineering, Product, Design) on the platform they build on.

Tech Stack:
- Cloud and IaC: AWS (EC2, EKS, S3, SQS, SNS, ECR, IAM, ALB), GCP (BigQuery), Cloudflare. Managed in Terraform.
- Container orchestration: Kubernetes on EKS, Helm, KEDA for SQS-driven autoscaling, ArgoCD for GitOps deploys. In-house canary system (augmenting with Argo Rollouts).
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions with self-hosted AWS runners (including KVM-capable instances for Android UI tests). Monorepo consolidation in progress.
- Observability: Datadog (logs, metrics, APM, spans), Sentry (errors), Incident.io and PagerDuty (incident lifecycle and postmortems).
- Networking: Cloudflare (Workers, Zero Trust, DNS), CloudFront, VPC peering, OctoDNS for DNS-as-code.
- Data stores: MongoDB (fronted by GraphQL), Elasticsearch, Redis.
- Languages: Node.js and TypeScript (most services), Python (selected services and tooling), PHP (legacy load-bearing services being gradually replaced).
- Local dev: Hermes running in OrbStack, pre-built production containers from ECR.

Required Skills:
- Production Kubernetes experience on a managed offering (GKE, EKS, AKS), including Helm charts, autoscaling (KEDA, cluster autoscaler).
- AWS depth: IAM, EC2, S3, SQS, ECR, ALBs. Cloudflare (WAF, Workers, Zero Trust, DNS). GCP (BigQuery).
- Strong Terraform skills, defaulting to modules.
- Production CI/CD with GitHub Actions and GitOps via ArgoCD, including canary/progressive delivery.
- Experience building internal developer tools (CLIs, dev environments, per-PR environments) as products.
- Datadog, Sentry, or similar observability stacks, designed with cost in mind.
- Comfortable reading/modifying TypeScript or Node services.
- Fluent with modern AI tools for debugging, documentation, and toil reduction.

Benefits: $164k-$212k + equity, 4-day workweeks, unlimited time off, $1,000 home office setup, health insurance, $1,000 growth mindset fund/year, free Kindle + unlimited books, AI tools stipend, profit sharing, 16 weeks family leave, 6-week paid sabbaticals every 5 years.

Senior Manager, Platform Engineering

Salary: EUR 120,000 - 140,000 + variable bonus | Location: Dublin, Ireland (Remote) | Full Time
Department: Engineering | Reports to: VP, Platform Engineering

About Prove:
Prove's phone-centric identity tokenization and passive cryptographic authentication solutions reduce friction and enhance security across digital channels. Over 1,000 enterprise customers use Prove's platform to process 20 billion customer requests annually across banking, lending, healthcare, gaming, crypto, e-commerce, marketplaces, and payments.

Job Summary:
Senior Manager leading two critical teams based in Ireland: Platform Developer Enablement and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). Responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of cloud infrastructure, driving transition toward greater platform maturity. Focus areas: developer self-service, extreme reliability (99.999% SLO), and advanced observability.

Key Focus Areas:
- Unified Platform Strategy: Lead strategic evolution of Platform Engineering and SRE teams; foster shared ownership and operational excellence.
- Internal Developer Platform (IDP): Drive development of internal platform services enabling product teams to self-service infrastructure needs.
- Reliability & SRE: Lead the team to achieve 99.999% internal SLO; establish incident management processes and train Incident Commanders.
- Process & Standardization: Create repeatable operational processes and documentation for clarity and efficiency.
- Observability 2.0: Implement company-wide observability standard based on OpenTelemetry instrumentation.

Responsibilities:

Leadership & Strategy:
- Lead, inspire, and manage two teams (Platform Developer Enablement & SRE).
- Set clear goals, hire and develop top talent, mentor engineering managers.
- Define the platform roadmap aligned with business objectives and technology strategy.
- Champion DevOps principles, automation, and IaC best practices across the organization.

Platform Development & Operations:
- Oversee design and operation of the platform to meet product and internal stakeholder needs.
- Drive architectural evolution for scalability, resilience, and security.
- Establish and maintain rigorous SLOs aligned with business requirements.
- Implement advanced observability, monitoring, and logging frameworks.

Collaboration & Communication:
- Partner with product management, security, and engineering leaders to translate business needs into platform capabilities.
- Ensure platform team acts as an enabler for product teams.
- Communicate technical risks and architectural trade-offs to technical and non-technical leadership.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
- 5+ years of senior-level experience as a Software Engineer, SRE, and/or Platform Engineer.
- 5+ years of management experience with proven success leading and coaching other managers.
- Deep experience running SaaS products in cloud environments (AWS preferred).
- Strong technical background with Kubernetes, Terraform, and modern CI/CD pipelines (GitOps, ArgoCD).
- Programming skills in Go, Java, or similar.
- Expertise in distributed systems design and architecture patterns.
- Advanced knowledge of observability practices, specifically OpenTelemetry.
- Familiarity with database technologies (MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB) and data streaming (Kafka, Redis).

DevOps & Cloud Engineer

Location: Saudi Arabia | Full Time | 1-3 years experience
Application: Send CV to Hr@definedsolutions.com
Source: LinkedIn post

About Defined Solutions:
Defined Solutions is a cloud and technology company helping organizations accelerate their cloud transformation through automation, scalability, and innovation. Based in Saudi Arabia.

About the Role:
Join the DevOps & Cloud Engineering team to build, automate, and innovate in the cloud. Work on modern cloud infrastructure, automation, containerization, and CI/CD projects while collaborating with experienced cloud professionals.

What You'll Work With:
- Cloud platforms: Microsoft Azure, AWS, and GCP.
- Containerization: Docker and Kubernetes.
- Infrastructure as Code: Terraform.
- CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD and GitHub Actions.
- Automation and scripting: Ansible, Bash, Python, and PowerShell.

Requirements:
- 1-3 years of DevOps or Cloud Engineering experience.
- Hands-on knowledge of cloud platforms and container technologies.
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code.
- Linux administration and scripting fundamentals.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Nice to Have:
- Cloud certifications: AZ-900, AZ-104, AWS Cloud Practitioner, or Terraform Associate.
